objective: Test whether pre-outcome semantic novelty improves the yield of a fixed investigation budget for LLM-origin findings relative to the current severity-and-confidence ordering, using existing findings only for protocol development and new independent repositories for evidence.

completed_eligibility_audit.effect: The existing cohort can exercise deterministic grouping, reference construction, ranking, and report plumbing but contributes no held-out outcomes.

claim_boundary.primary_question: At a fixed budget of three LLM-origin findings per independent evaluation family, does a frozen semantic-novelty ordering surface more project-owner-confirmed actionable findings than the current severity-and-confidence ordering?
claim_boundary.allowed_claim: A descriptive held-out comparison of two frozen investigation orderings over the protocol cohort.
not_claimed: causal effectiveness outside the reviewed cohort
optimal novelty threshold or review budget
production readiness or permission to change queue policy
benefit for supply_chain or agentic_surface lenses

existing_protocol_development_corpus.population: The digest-frozen 63 source_lens finding records audited by opt009-existing-llm-eligibility-v1.
permitted_uses: construct the outcome-blind OWASP semantic reference inventory
test deterministic duplicate grouping, ranking, packet-union, and report schemas

prospective_evidence_corpus.target: Eight independent production or deployment repository families with six decided OWASP-lens issue groups per family.
prospective_evidence_corpus.chronology: Every source identity, candidate identity, semantic reference digest, novelty score, stratum, baseline rank, novelty rank, and packet membership must be persisted before the first human assessment in its wave.

allowed_inputs: public repository identity, default branch, exact commit, license, archive/fork state, and approximate repository size
README-level evidence that the repository is a deployable product or service
declared primary language and framework ancestry
absence from the frozen RepoAuditor acquisition and evaluation-family inventory
required_breadth: at least three distinct primary-language or framework ancestries across the eight primaries
no two repositories from the same upstream, fork, clone, pre/post pair, or product family
each repository exposes application, authorization, workflow, data, or service boundaries suitable for static investigation
forbidden_inputs: security advisories, CVEs, security issues, security pull requests, exploit reports, or answer keys
source-code inspection beyond README-level product/deployment metadata
scanner or LLM findings, candidate counts, target paths, severity, confidence, novelty, labels, or outcomes
inclusion of an intentionally vulnerable, benchmark, tutorial, starter-template, manufactured, or protected-holdout repository
source_selection.activation_of_reserves: Activate reserves only in their frozen order when a primary cannot materialize at its exact commit, fails a required preflight, or yields fewer than eight eligible deduplicated OWASP-lens candidates. Candidate outcomes may never activate a reserve.

frozen_detection_identity.interpretation: Only OWASP-lens findings enter the primary comparison because the frozen reference has 61 OWASP records but only two supply-chain records and zero agentic-surface records. Observational lenses cannot satisfy the data or benefit gates.

candidate_eligible_only_if: source_lens equals owasp under the exact frozen prompt identity
citation integrity validation passed against the exact source snapshot
no assessment, manual label, answer key, or known outcome existed before ranking
not generated, vendored, documentation, example, test, CI-only, package-hygiene-only, or secret-history-only evidence
eligibility_and_grouping.issue_grouping: Within one evaluation family, conservatively collapse same-issue matches before ranking. One issue group contributes at most one review identity and one outcome.
eligibility_and_grouping.representative: Choose the lexicographically smallest stable identity hash within each group; do not use severity, confidence, novelty, or outcomes.
eligibility_and_grouping.shortfall_rule: If fewer than eight groups remain, record the shortfall, activate the next frozen reserve, and exclude the short family from gate denominators without replacing candidates based on outcomes.

reference.population: All 61 pre-cutoff OWASP source_lens finding records in inventory 6fd81f874cc201025fde1afd91b5e0f0196a2b0d7148a95ab90927a253b9c5a9, collapsed by the frozen normalization signature without reading assessments.

forbidden_fields: assessment, label, score, rank, suppression, prior, or known vulnerability
novelty_definition.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, replace non-alphanumeric runs with one space, discard numeric-only tokens, retain unique unigrams and adjacent bigrams from the normalized token sequence, then serialize the set in sorted order.
novelty_definition.similarity: Maximum Jaccard similarity between the candidate token set and any frozen reference token set.
novelty_definition.novelty_score: 1 minus maximum similarity; higher means less similar to the pre-cutoff reference.

strata.in_family: maximum similarity greater than or equal to 0.35
strata.guard_band: maximum similarity greater than 0.15 and less than 0.35
strata.out_of_family: maximum similarity less than or equal to 0.15

novelty_definition.threshold_policy: The two similarity cut points are design constants with a guard band, not empirically optimized operating thresholds. They may not be changed after source selection. Primary benefit uses continuous novelty rank, not the strata cut points.

frozen_comparison.evaluation_unit: Deduplicated OWASP-lens issue group within an independent evaluation family.
frozen_comparison.baseline_order: Severity ordinal descending, model confidence descending, stable identity hash ascending; this reproduces the current untriaged fallback with an explicit deterministic tie-break.
frozen_comparison.novelty_order: Novelty score descending, then the complete baseline order as tie-break.
frozen_comparison.review_packet_per_family: Outcome-blind union of the top three baseline and top three novelty identities, filled to exactly six unique identities by stable identity hash if the union has fewer than six.
frozen_comparison.abstention: insufficient_evidence is retained, never imputed, and does not enter a decided denominator.
frozen_comparison.primary_metric: Paired family-level and aggregate difference in confirmed-actionable yield among the top three novelty identities versus the top three baseline identities.
secondary_metrics: top-three technically-valid yield, reported separately from actionability
overlap and discordant identity counts between the two orderings
continuous average precision over reviewed identities, descriptive only
counts by novelty stratum, repository family, and disposition
frozen_comparison.uncertainty: Two-thousand-resample 95% evaluation-family-block percentile interval with seed 2009 over the paired top-three actionable-yield difference.

conditions: at least 48 decided issue groups across at least eight independent evaluation families
at least six decided issue groups per counted family
at least eight confirmed-actionable and eight decided non-actionable outcomes
at least twelve decided in-family and twelve decided out-of-family outcomes
zero chronology failures and at least twelve discordant top-three identity slots across the cohort
data_sufficiency.effect: Satisfying this gate permits the frozen held-out benefit report. It does not establish benefit or authorize implementation.

conditions: the novelty ordering surfaces at least three more confirmed-actionable findings in aggregate at the same fixed family budgets
family wins exceed family losses by at least two, with ties retained
the family-block 95% interval lower bound is not below zero
held_out_benefit.effect_if_met: OPT-009 may proceed only to a separately authorized bounded implementation decision; no production policy changes are implied.
held_out_benefit.effect_if_not_met: Retain the negative result and consider closing OPT-009 as not justified at this scope; do not tune cut points, alter the packet, or add post hoc endpoints.

fail_closed_rules: Any audit result, reference inventory, prompt, model, normalization, source, commit, family, ranking, packet, or chronology identity drifts.
Fewer than eight activated independent families can each supply eight eligible candidate groups after all frozen reserves are exhausted.
Any source or candidate is selected using security outcomes, findings, candidate counts other than the declared reserve trigger, or human dispositions.
Any ranking, packet, or novelty field is created or changed after the first assessment in its wave.
Any data-sufficiency condition fails; publish the shortfall without computing a gate-passing benefit claim.
Do not rescore, tune, recalibrate, change similarity cut points, select another budget, train a novelty model, or change production policy during collection or evaluation.

authorized_by_this_protocol_freeze: use of the existing ineligible cohort for protocol-development tests without outcomes
not_authorized: candidate generation, persistence, ranking, packet selection, or disclosure
model training, tuning, threshold selection, production policy, promotion, or closure
phase_authority.next_approval: The separate source-selection receipt freezes a metadata-only GitHub phase. Acquisition and LLM detection require a later receipt after exact repositories and commits are reviewed.
